newsitem.title: USA: MascoTech to buy some Teksid steel units.
newsitem.headline: MascoTech to buy some Teksid steel units.

text.p: MascoTech Inc said it signed a memorandum of understanding with Teksid SpA to acquire certain of Teksid's Steel Components Division businesses.

MascoTech said it expects to acquire most of the Steel Components Division operations at Avigliana, Italy, as well as in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. Teksid, however, would retain a minority stake in these operations.

A MascoTech spokesman said these operations would complement existing steel forging operations in Germany, the United Kingdom and the Czech Republic. The company also has an after-market parts operation in Italy.
The portion of Teksid's Steel Components Division to be included in the transaction had 1996 sales of about $150 million, out of Teksid's total sales of about $1.5 billion.
The Steel Components Division supplies cold, warm and hot forged engine, drivetrain and chassis components to Fiat and other European and South American customers.
The transaction is subject to due diligence, execution of a definitive agreement, regulatory approvals and approval by the respective boards of directors.
The final agreement will be negotiated over the next several months, MascoTech said. If successful, a transaction would close around year-end 1997.
